mission: Deliver evidence-backed reviewable CONTRADICTS candidates and a human-approval path resolving as atomic SUPERSEDES, with detection never mutating authority.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

phases.name: Fixture spike
phases.exit: Hard gate: all five Deferred-spike-B assertions (identity/anchor matching, symmetric-edge representation, duplicate suppression, unresolved-conflict visibility, candidate-to-approved transition) plus the folded boundary fixtures (competing lineages, revision ordering, restart boundary) pass against the real core in the PGlite lane at minimum, with pass/fail per assertion archived under history/p0/.

phases.name: Implement
phases.exit: Candidate domain values/entities, additive tables + generated migration, use-case ports/commands including the conflicted ClaimDispositionStatus member, and the server repository + layer land on the P0-proven design; the core's tables are unaltered.

phases.name: Verify
phases.exit: Two-axis queries over open and resolved candidates, the approval-to-atomic-supersession race lane (opt-in pattern per standards/architecture/08-testing.md), and restart/migration proof are green, and bun run beep yeet verify reports SUCCESS.

phases.name: Yeet: PR to mergeable
phases.exit: PR published via bun run beep yeet publish --pr and driven to mergeable with hosted required checks green.

phases.name: Close
phases.exit: Closeout reflection passes bun run beep lint reflection-artifacts and the packet-state flip (manifest + README) lands in the same PR as the final work.

stopConditions: Required source files are missing or materially contradictory.
The implementation would exceed named scope, especially any pressure to add detection heuristics or NLP inference.
Verification requires unnamed credentials, cost, destructive side effects, or policy approval.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
